title: Jordan psionically calls in an 'egg' object that Fred Baker films
place_text: Skywatcher event site, patio and backyard

tellings.quote: One example: in August one of our main psi-actives, Jordan, probably caused object, and it could to be an "egg". I don't know What is this?

plain: In August 2024, at an event site with a patio and backyard, one of Skywatcher's main "psi-actives", a man named Jordan Jose, is said to have used his mind to call in an object that may have been shaped like an "egg", and a man named Fred Baker filmed it. Skywatcher is a startup that tries to summon UFOs, and "psi-actives" is its word for people it says have psychic abilities. A witness speaking for the company tells it as an example of their work, saying Jordan "probably caused" the object, and admits they don't know what it was.
